_comment: Text-model routing for scripts (scripts/llm.py). With the OPENROUTER_API_KEY secret set, the tasks listed in openrouter_tasks try free OpenRouter models first and fall back to OpenAI (gpt-4.1) if they are rate-limited, down or return unusable JSON. Free tier: 20 requests/min, 50/day (1,000/day after a one-time $10 credit). Add "narrated_script" to openrouter_tasks to move the live narrated series to free models too (test it first: gpt-4.1 was chosen for writing quality). openrouter_free_models is tried first if those models are still free; then the best free models OpenRouter currently lists; then the openrouter/free router.
